formal_coverage.status: partial mechanisms; no complete manuscript row claimed
formal_coverage.boundary: Lean proves the abstract pinching, involution, conductor, golden-character, tight-frame, switching, Petersen-eigenspace, fixed-line, and scalar-normalization mechanisms. It does not prove the global Hitchin incidence and Stein identifications, the scheme-theoretic chart correspondence, the geometric golden-fibre identification, face-axis geometry and the spherical addition theorem, or the raw degree-six moment. Therefore none of ARITH-1, ARITH-2, ORIENT-1, HARM-1, or HARM-2 is claimed at full manuscript strength.

clauses: rational incidence model, quadratic function field, and global Stein double-cover algebra
conjugate Clebsch charts, their completed conductor model and canonical map to the incidence normalization, and the identity iota_t^*J0=16 sigma3^2
claims.statement: Hitchin's rational icosahedral incidence extension has function field Q(P(H))(sqrt(5J0)), and its Stein algebra is O plus O(-3) with anti-invariant multiplication z^2=5J0 after normalization of the generator; each conjugate Clebsch chart is defined over Q(sqrt(5)), not Q, the charts meet only at xyz and descend to a Q-scheme whose completed conductor and normalization recover Q(sqrt(5)), their fixed-parent sections map canonically to the incidence normalization, and each chart pulls J0 back to 16 sigma3^2.
claims.proof_role: human proof using Hitchin's incidence degree, branch divisor, Clebsch chart, invariant calculation, and the trace-split rank-one reflexive Stein algebra on projective space

claims.statement: The complete reduced fibre over xyz has residue algebra Q(sqrt(5)); over every odd finite field where 5 is a nonzero square, its displayed configurations are exchanged by R with spinor class [2], which is nontrivial modulo 11.
claims.proof_role: quadratic pinching and signed Gram-determinant proof, with the displayed coordinates retained as an independent regression audit

clauses: normalization of the pulled-back incidence cover into two chart components
relative marked source convention and its golden-fibre identification with conference and triangle-cubic reversal
label-compatible primitive Petersen comparison and relative harmonic sign transport
claims.statement: The normalized pullback of Hitchin's incidence cover to the golden Clebsch chart is the disjoint union of two normal chart components, while the unnormalized branches are distinct exactly on D(sigma3). After an ordered golden realization, normalized chart lift, and compatible plane-triple and Petersen labels are supplied, the selected component is assigned [C_m,Z_m]_or and the other its deck-opposite; the golden exchanger identifies the opposite with (-C_m,-Z_m) at xyz, and the marked primitive pair-sum map transports this relative sign to the degree-six Gaunt cubic. The incidence sheet alone is not asserted to determine the marking or lift.
claims.proof_role: split-quadratic pinching, tight-frame conference identities, and an explicit relative-marking proof using Hitchin's branch and chart theorems, with a golden-fibre equivariance witness and exact regression audit

claims.statement: The ten explicitly labelled face-axis zonal harmonics embed the 1+4+5 permutation module into H_6, with normalized spherical Gram matrix one thirteenth of the reproducing kernel and the Clebsch four-space equal to the Petersen minus-two eigenspace; after the five objects are identified, the abstract A5-equivariant comparison is uniquely fixed by preserving sigma3.
claims.proof_role: two-orbit Petersen kernel calculation, representation-theoretic eigenspace proof, and exact regression audit

claims.statement: The normalized degree-six spherical cubic restricts to -784000/1247103 times sigma3 on the Clebsch four-space.
